'''Ulaire Cantea Bow before me, B/0TCH!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ulaire Cantea]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed BHBM Cantea DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Fun BHBM (i know, bhbm may be wierd), but it wins.

== Strategy ==

Ok, start the stuff, activate, pull the Emperor and force lighning so . Drain everywhere. Send the probe droids out to search for amidala. Drain for ever, don't give up, and play it out. Be sure to battle a few times to get those cards stacked on your destiny.  Cross luke, and thats the end.

Emerson "Sparkz" Sklar
Ulaire Cantea

NOTE: BHBM is not dead, it was just hibernating.
